description_en: Queries the usage data of online editing in ApsaraVideo VOD
description_zh: 调用DescribeVodEditingUsageData查询点播云剪辑用量
kebab_example: aliyun vod describe-vod-editing-usage-data --start-time 2024-11-06T16:00:00Z --end-time 2024-11-07T16:00:00Z --biz-region cn-beijing --specification H264.SD --app-id app-0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVodEditingUsageData

parameters.description_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

If you leave this parameter empty, data from the last 24 hours is queried by default.
parameters.description_zh:
获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ。

若为空，则默认读取最近24小时的数据。
